info.title: PocketOps implemented API
info.description: Identity, GitHub App repository APIs, guarded source editing and manual Render deployments. Unversioned health/auth aliases are legacy aliases. Provider credentials never belong in bearer authentication. Webhooks require HMAC over raw bytes, not a PocketOps session.
